title: Gutter Cleaning Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Gutter Cleaning: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Gutter Cleaning Estimate Worksheet covers gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris. The gutter service coordinator records Residential Gutter Cleaning observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Gutter Cleaning Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Gutter Cleaning exceptions visible until the gutter service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Gutter Cleaning Estimate Worksheet at residence perimeter, roof edge, ladder position, discharge point, and protected landscaping. Document gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris identity before Residential Gutter Cleaning begins. Compare gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris findings with stated Residential Gutter Cleaning criteria; route unresolved Residential Gutter Cleaning issues to exterior service supervisor. For Gutter Cleaning Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Residential Gutter Cleaning. Ask exterior service supervisor to review Residential Gutter Cleaning conditions beyond the gutter service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Estimate assumptions and customer decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Gutter Cleaning conditions; have gutter service coordinator assign the next Residential Gutter Cleaning owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Pricing assumptions, exclusions, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe ladder, edge, weather, or power-line proximity
Loose gutter or damaged fascia cannot support work
Downspout blockage requires disassembly beyond scope
Water discharge creates property or erosion concern
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Gutter Cleaning when access, edge, weather, electrical proximity, unstable attachment, or unsafe discharge remains. Retain the available Residential Gutter Cleaning proof and route unresolved gutter run, outlet, downspout, discharge, roof edge, and collected debris scope to gutter service coordinator.
